items.title: LabLLM
items.summary: A native macOS lab for teaching tiny language models to think — build the architecture, train the weights, and watch a small LLM emerge from scratch, locally on Apple Silicon with custom data, tokenizers, checkpoints, and MLX acceleration.

items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses using dense token-level guidance from a stronger teacher. items.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
items.title_cn: 由于“奇点” ， Stripe并没有真正购买OpenRouter

items.summary_cn: 对于在不同人工智能模型之间路由提示的初创公司，支付巨头想要什么？ Stripe说这是因为“奇点” ，但这真的是一个更真实、更有力的原因。
